subject: owls vanishing rodent control
title: What If Every Owl on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every owl on Earth vanished tonight? The night's quietest pest control would quit.
From night one, rodents stop disappearing. An adult barn owl eats at least one a night.
A nesting family hunts far more. In California vineyards, one barn owl family can remove up to four thousand rodents a year.
A 2023 Napa Valley study found vineyards with more owls had thirty-eight to fifty-two percent fewer rodents. That gap would close.
Farms would turn back to poison. In Israel, after about three thousand owl boxes went up, rodent poison permit requests fell fifty to ninety percent.
And each rodent would cost more: about twenty-six cents with owls, over eight dollars by trapping.

description:
What if every owl vanished? A three-year study found adult barn owls eat at least one rodent per night, about 26 cents per rodent removed versus $8.11 for trapping, and Cal Poly Humboldt researchers report one barn owl family can remove up to 4,000 rodents a year; a 2023 Napa Valley study found 38-52% fewer rodents in vineyards with more owls.
In Israel, after about 3,000 barn owl nest boxes were installed, permit applications for field rodenticide fell 50-90% (Tel Aviv University).
